notes.title: Release 1.1.1
notes.content:
In this update the Unreal version was updated and some bugs were fixed.
In addition, an option was added so that player 1 is not assigned to a controller and can therefore play with a keyboard.

notes.title: Forge Squad - Patch 1.1 Bug Fixes and Balancing
notes.content:
Change log:
+ Fixed a bug that prevented a level from being completed (missing Victory Screen).
+ The difficulty level Easy has been simplified again to not overwhelm new players.
+ Some typos have been fixed.
+ Tutorial signpost has been added because we noticed that some players overlooked the tutorial.

notes.title: Forge Squad will be released on 10th November 2021
notes.content:
Only one more week, then Forge Squad will be released. We are currently polish the game and testing intensively.

We would also like to point out our Discord server. There you can find other players or get in contact with us developers directly.

Follow our invitation link: [url=https://discord.gg/npBPV5aSGp]https://discord.gg/npBPV5aSGp[/url]
